queries_run: Visa 10-K customer concentration clients percent of net revenue largest clients
Visa credit rating 2026 S&P Moody's AA-

findings.claim: Visa FY2022 10-K：一個客戶占淨營收10%（FY2021為11%）；FY2020有兩個客戶分別占11%與10%；FY2018–19無客戶超過10%。未取得FY2023–26數字。
findings.excerpt: In fiscal 2022 and fiscal 2021, the Company had one client that accounted for 10% and 11% of its total net revenues, respectively.

findings.claim: S&P於2018年11月將Visa長短期發行人評級升至AA-/A-1+，展望穩定；2025年4月S&P給予歐元優先無擔保債AA-。搜尋未見2026年評級調整。
findings.source: S&P Global Ratings via Alacra: Visa Inc.'s Proposed Euro-Denominated Senior Unsecured Debt Rated 'AA-'

customer_concentration_credit.note: Visa客戶為發卡行/收單行；FY2023–26 10-K客戶集中度未查到；2026年無降評/破產線索（僅兩次搜尋，未做bankruptcy/guidance cut專查）。
